summary: Verified client-side video export feature. Backend POST /api/course/{project_id}/export-video-frames returns valid base64 frames (10 frames for test project). Frontend shows single 'Gerar Video (WebM)' button, progress bar updates correctly, and video download works. All 12 backend tests passed. SCORM and HTML exports still work (regression verified).
